title: 第13章 曦瑶你可要沐浴更衣第14章 危机再起仙道宗门来袭
slug: 重生魔帝开局骗女帝下界双修
content_zh:
不知道过了多久。
也许是几个时辰之后。
静室里，空气还残留着亲热的余温。
产自药王谷的灵烛，火苗跳动着，映得墙壁忽明忽暗。
林云斜靠在乱七八糟的软榻上，微微喘着粗气。
目光落在身旁的女帝祖师，姬曦瑶的身上。
她半倚着床头，纱裙凌乱的盖着小腹，香汗淋漓地贴在白皙的肌肤上。
长长的发丝黏在额头，胸口微微起伏。
显然刚刚又经历了对她来说相当于噩梦的事情。
一次又一次，自己还能再相信他么？
姬曦瑶整个人像是被揉碎了一般，美艳得让人挪不开眼睛。
林云盯着她，眼底闪过一丝愧疚。
毕竟这总是么折腾人家，多少有点不地道。
而且，信任度这种东西可不好培养。
不过有时候也怪不得自己。
林老魔承认自己是禽兽。
所以这念头刚冒出来，就被心底那股炙热压了下去。
他舔了舔嘴唇，似乎又起了心思。
但是现在显然已经不合时宜了。
姬曦瑶喘息稍定。

似乎是察觉到了林云那不老实的眼神。
她猛地转头瞪过来，眼里冰冷的像是淬了毒，赤裸裸的杀意浓得能滴水。
姬曦瑶咬牙切齿，声音低得像从喉咙里挤出来：“你这该死的蝼蚁！你言而无信！”
“你还是不是男人！我圣宗怎么会出你这样的无耻之徒！”
她攥紧拳头，指甲掐进掌心，恨不得扑上去撕了他。
“林云，我要将你千刀万剐！让你魂飞魄散，连轮回的机会都没有！”
她的声音颤抖着，带着无尽的怨毒。
凤眸里泪光一闪，却被她硬生生憋回去，绝不让这畜生看到她半点软弱。
林云却跟没听见似的，厚着脸皮凑过去。
让她发泄骂一顿得了，自己又不会少块肉。
林老魔笑得一脸欠揍：“曦瑶，别生气嘛，谁让你太美了，怨不得我。”
“哎，其实我也很累啊，你看，我气息都不稳了。”
他一边说，一边伸手想去摸她的脸。
语气里带着点哄骗的味道：“你这模样，天上的仙女都比不上，你说我一个凡人，哪忍得住啊？”
他这话说得油腻又无赖，偏偏还装出一副深情款款的样子。
也就欺负人家真的是仙女之中的绝美女帝，没有经历过这些市井无赖的套路。
姬曦瑶冷哼一声，狠狠拍开他的手，怒道：
content_en:
I don’t know how long it took.
Maybe a few hours later.
In the quiet room, the air still retains the warmth of intimacy.
The flames of the spiritual candle produced in Yaowang Valley flickered, making the walls flicker.
Lin Yun was leaning on the messy soft couch, breathing heavily.
His eyes fell on the empress ancestor Ji Xiyao beside him.
She was half-leaning on the head of the bed, her gauze skirt messily covering her lower abdomen, and her fragrant sweat clinging to her fair skin.
Her long hair stuck to her forehead, and her chest rose and fell slightly.
It was obvious that she had just experienced something that was equivalent to a nightmare for her.
Time and time again, can I trust him again?
Ji Xiyao's whole figure seemed to have been crushed into pieces, and she was so beautiful that people couldn't take their eyes away.
Lin Yun stared at her, a trace of guilt flashing in his eyes.
After all, this is always tormenting others, which is somewhat unethical.
Moreover, trust is not a difficult thing to cultivate.
But sometimes I can’t blame myself.
Lin Laomo admitted that he was a beast.
So as soon as this thought came up, it was suppressed by the burning heat in my heart.
He licked his lips and seemed to be thinking about it again.
But it is clearly out of date now.
Ji Xiyao took a breath and calmed down.
It seemed that he noticed Lin Yun's dishonest eyes.
She suddenly turned her head and stared at him, her eyes as cold as if they were quenched with poison, and her naked murderous intent was so thick that it could drip.
Ji Xiyao gritted her teeth and her voice was as low as being squeezed out of her throat: "You damn ant! You don't keep your word!"
"You are still not a man! How could our Holy Sect have such a shameless person like you!"
She clenched her fists and dug her nails into her palms, wanting to pounce on him and tear him apart.
"Lin Yun, I will cut you to pieces with a thousand knives! Your soul will be scattered, and you won't even have a chance to be reincarnated!"
Her voice trembled with endless resentment.
Tears flashed in Feng's eyes, but she forced them back, not letting this beast see the slightest bit of weakness in her.
Lin Yun, however, acted as if he hadn't heard anything and moved forward shamelessly.
Just let her vent and scold her, and I won't lose a piece of meat.
Old Devil Lin smiled so hard that he said, "Xiyao, don't be angry. You are so beautiful that you can't blame me."
"Hey, I'm actually very tired too. Look, I can't even breathe."
As he spoke, he reached out to touch her face.
There was a hint of coaxing in his tone: "You look like this, even the fairies in the sky can't compare to you. How can you say that I, a mortal, can bear it?"
What he said was greasy and rogue, but he still pretended to be affectionate.
That is to say, she is really a beautiful queen among fairies and has never experienced the tricks of these market scoundrels.
Ji Xiyao snorted coldly, slapped his hand away, and said angrily:
